preview.notes: The visitor Theme Gallery launcher is directly visible beside Quick Actions in the sticky header, including at #contact. Former gallery was buried inside a closed menu and requested its catalog with credentials omitted, which could fail on Cloudflare Access protected previews. Theme data is now strictly bundled and verified against the saved six-theme catalog; zero runtime HTTP requests are needed. Frozen Editorial hero/style and all real personal data remain unchanged; server owner management absent and private requests disabled. Browser/CI visual acceptance still pending because CircleCI credits exhausted.
